G1_unambiguity.justification: The processors, memory banks, allowed pairs, required one-to-one activation, and output format are stated clearly enough to permit only one reasonable interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary bounds, input fields, validity conditions, output requirements, and the allowance to choose any valid configuration are provided.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The rewritten task is exactly the same perfect-bipartite-matching problem, and its two additional guaranteed properties are logically redundant under the stated input constraints.

G4_naturalness.justification: The cluster and bus framing is readable and idiomatic overall, though the guaranteed properties are redundant and the phrase “connected across all processors” is somewhat awkward.
